HEXEDIT.ExplorationTooltip: What is the knowledge level of the party for this hex?
HEXEDIT.ClearedTooltip: Has the party cleared the hex? This may involve some time consuming actions
HEXEDIT.ClaimedTooltip: Has any country or faction liad claim to this hex?
HEXEDIT.ShowToPlayersTooltip: If checked, this item will be visible to players
HEXEDIT.Name: A custom name for this feature, e.g. the name of a river.
HEXEDIT.ExtractedTooltip: Resource extracted by this improvement. Leave on automatic to use a matching deposit of the hex or roll one according to the spawn weights.
HEXEDIT.Title: Hex {hex}

REMOVE.Title: Remove Chex
REMOVE.Info: Removes all Chex related data from this scene. This can't be undone.

Error.TooSmall: The settlement is too small for this building.
Error.NoLots: Not enough free lots in this settlement.
Error.MaxCount: This settlement already has the maximum number of these buildings.
Error.NoPermission: You are not allowed to manage this realm.
Error.NoGM: A GM needs to be logged in to change a realm.
Error.HexOccupied: There already is a settlement on this hex.
Error.TradeCantAfford: One of the realms can no longer afford this trade.
Error.UnknownOffer: This offer or agreement no longer exists.

ECONOMY.AmountsHint: Leave 0 for resources that aren't involved.
ECONOMY.NoRealms: There is no player kingdom yet. The GM chooses it in the cHex settings under Realms.

Kingdom.Title: Kingdom
Kingdom.TurnTT: Economic turns ended for this realm.
Kingdom.HappinessTT: Last turn → next turn. Percentage of settlement needs that were met.
Kingdom.EndTurnConfirm: End the economic turn of {realm}? Production, upkeep, settlement needs, drains and trade agreements are applied.
Kingdom.EmptyStockpile: Nothing stored and nothing produced yet.
Kingdom.CreateSettlementHint: Place the settlement on the map from the hex editor (double-click a claimed hex).
Kingdom.WorkSitesTT: Improvements on hexes claimed by this realm, on all cHex scenes.
Kingdom.NoWorkSites: No improvements produce anything for this realm.
Kingdom.DrainsTT: Ongoing costs like armies, garrisons or envoys. Paid after the settlements.
Kingdom.DropActor: Drop an actor here, e.g. an army, to add it as a drain.

Settlement.Title: Settlement
Settlement.NotPlacedTT: Not placed on the map. The GM can place it from the hex editor.
Settlement.Unplace: Remove from map (the settlement is kept)
Settlement.NeedsTT: Consumed every turn. Received in the next turn / needed.
Settlement.IdleTT: Its upkeep can't be paid next turn, so it won't produce anything.
Settlement.ClaimFirst: Save a claim for this hex to found a settlement here.
Settlement.Transferred: {name} now belongs to {to} (before: {from}). Its buildings came along, the stockpile of {from} did not.

Trade.Title: Trade
Trade.Hint: The other realm accepts or declines the offer in its kingdom view. One-time trades are exchanged on acceptance, recurring ones every turn of this realm.
Trade.BalanceTT: Value received minus value given, based on the trade values of the resources.
Trade.RecurringTT: A trade agreement, exchanged at the end of each turn of the proposing realm as long as both sides can pay.
Trade.FailedTT: Failed last time, one side couldn't pay.
Trade.WillFailTT: Will fail next turn, one side can't pay.
Trade.Notification: {from} offers a trade to {to}. Open the kingdom view of {to} to respond.

MAPVIEW.Title: Map View
MAPVIEW.OverlayOff: Enable the cHex overlay to see these on the map.

CHEX.IdTT: Internal identifier, ONLY use letters and numbers. DO NOT use spaces. Make sure that it is unique within its group.
CHEX.Label: Label

Error.InvalidGrid: cHex only works with the grid types Hexagonal Rows - Odd and Hexagonal Columns - Odd.

CONFIG.Title: cHex Configuration
CONFIG.DefaultsAdded: Added {count} default entries. Save to keep them.
CONFIG.ImportHint: Select a JSON file exported from the cHex configuration. It replaces the unsaved entries of every category it contains.
CONFIG.InvalidId: Invalid or duplicate ID "{id}" in {tab}. IDs may only contain letters, numbers, - and _.
CONFIG.ResourcesHint: Raw resources are found on the map and extracted by improvements. Goods are made by buildings. Changing an ID breaks existing references to it.
CONFIG.ImprovementsHint: Improvements are placed on hexes. Extracting improvements produce one of their raw resources every turn for the realm that claimed the hex. Click the Extracts cell to choose them.
CONFIG.BuildingsHint: Buildings are constructed in settlements. Their cost is paid once, upkeep every turn. Buildings that can't pay their upkeep are idle for the turn.
CONFIG.SizesHint: Settlements consume their needs every turn. Their happiness is the percentage of needs that were met.
CONFIG.ExtractionHint: A category selects all of its resources, including ones added later. Toggle single resources to narrow it down or to combine resources of different categories. When placed on a hex, a matching deposit is used, otherwise one of the selected resources is rolled by spawn weight.

Field.categoryTT: Where raw resources are found. Improvements extract resources of one category.
Field.groupTT: Optional. Needs and costs can ask for any resource of a group, e.g. food.
Field.spawnWeightTT: Relative likelihood of being rolled when an improvement is placed on a hex without a matching deposit. 0 means never.
Field.tradeValueTT: Used to compare offers in trades.
Field.extractsTT: Raw resources this improvement can extract. Click to choose.
Field.yieldTT: Units produced per turn. Multiplied by the amount of a deposit on the hex.
Field.travelTT: Steps by which the travel difficulty of the hex changes. -1 makes travel easier by one step.
Field.minSizeTT: Smallest settlement size this can be built in.
Field.maxCountTT: Maximum number per settlement. 0 for unlimited.
Field.rankTT: Order of sizes, higher is bigger. Used for minimum size of buildings.
Field.defaultTravelTT: The ID of the travel that is the default difficulty for this terrain.
Field.multiplierTT: How many times more time does it take to travel here?
Field.specialTT: Is this a special travel type? If true, it will be skipped when an improvement lowers or increases the travel difficulty via its formula

Hint.realms: Realms claim hexes and have an economy. The player kingdom is managed by the players, all other realms by the GM.
Hint.terrains: Terrains color the map and set the default travel of hexes painted with them.
Hint.travels: Travel types and how much longer travel takes. Improvements like roads shift between the non-special types, ordered by multiplier.
Hint.features: Features are things on a hex that rarely change, like rivers or ruins. They can be named per hex.

CONFIG.PlayerRealmTT: The realm the players manage. They can open its kingdom view and settlements, build, trade and manage its drains. All other realms are run by the GM.
CONFIG.HeraldryTT: Flag or heraldry of the realm. Click to choose an image. It is shown together with the realm color.

PAINT.Title: Paint
PAINT.BucketTT: Click a hex to change all connected hexes with the same terrain or claim.

Hint.area: Click or drag over hexes to paint them. Works while the cHex controls are active.
Hint.click: Click a hex to add the selection or update it, Shift+click to remove it. Painting a deposit makes extracting improvements on the hex use it.

PAINT.FillConfirm: Change {count} connected hex(es) from {from} to {to}, starting at {start}? They are highlighted on the map.

CHANGES.Title: cHex {version}: What's New
CHANGES.Intro: The most important changes of this version. You only see this once.

Economy.Title: Kingdom economy
Economy.Text: Realms have a stockpile, settlements with buildings and happiness, drains like armies and an End Turn with a chat report. Open it with the crown in the token controls.

Trade.Title: Trade and the player kingdom
Trade.Text: Realms trade once or every turn. Choose a player kingdom in the configuration; players manage it themselves.

Resources.Title: Resources and improvements
Resources.Text: Raw resources are found underground, on the surface or in water. Mines, farms and fisheries extract a deposit of the hex or roll one. Old improvement formulas were converted.

Paint.Title: One paint palette
Paint.Text: Paint terrain, realms, improvements and resources from one palette, including filling whole areas. It replaces the terrain and realm palettes.

MapView.Title: Map View
MapView.Text: Choose what the overlay colors by and show settlements, improvements, resources or production on the map. Stored per user.

Config.Title: One configuration window
Config.Text: Realms with heraldry, terrains, travel, features and the economy are configured in one window with import and export.

Hex.Title: Hex editor and overlay
Hex.Text: The hex editor and the hover overlay were rebuilt. Double-click a hex to edit it.

Foundry.Title: Foundry v14 required
Foundry.Text: cHex now requires Foundry VTT version 14.
